verdict.rationale: Bugbot's own docs say it analyzes every PR for bugs and security issues, not only style, with a high-effort mode that finds 35% more bugs. Hands-on users say it 'finds genuine bugs most reviewers miss' with few frivolous comments, though one user saw it flip-flop on a suggested fix. Missing for 10: no documentation or hands-on evidence that it specifically catches logic errors, race conditions or broken edge cases; no independent accuracy or false-positive measurement; the 35% figure is vendor-reported only.

support.subject: As a developer, the reviewer catches real bugs in my PR — logic errors, race conditions, broken edge cases — not just style nits

citations.quote: It analyzes every pull request for bugs, security vulnerabilities, and code quality issues, leaving inline comments with explanations and suggested fixes.
Bugbot with high effort finds 35% more bugs while resolution rate stays constant at 80%.
almost none of its comments are frivolous or wrong, and it finds genuine bugs most reviewers miss.
I've found Bugbot to be shockingly effective at finding bugs in my PRs.
